scope: Achievement overview summary data phase only. Random isolated synthetic MySQL schema, 120 and 600 achievements with submissions and audit logs; common permission state initialized before timing, one warm-up discarded, median of five sequential samples. Full-projection comparison already uses batched scope metadata; this is not an exact pre-batch permission benchmark, HTTP/page latency, P95 or concurrent-user acceptance.

implementation.administrator_summary: One SQL aggregate over the original is_delete=0 records; date boundaries use the existing Asia/Shanghai connection convention. Preserves achievement counts separately from all nine award quantities, null quantities, current status, missing-date warning across years and empty values. No history, body or name projections for this summary.
implementation.scoped_drilldown: Permission metadata limited to requested IDs, deduplicated and read in batches of at most 500. Reuses the original row-scope matcher. Account and leadership relationships reused only within this invocation, never across requests; ordinary canRead behavior retained.

scope_query_evidence.limits: Mocked query-count assertion, not live SQL tracing or scan-row measurement.
